integration_notes.text: gap-disposition.json explicitly corrects prior core result_type wording: single-input discovered descriptor can depend on integer range; multi-input exact Python weak-scalar abstraction is the narrower no-value-based-promotion path.
All earlier acquisition outcomes are historical source receipts verified from local raw responses; no acquisition was replayed by this reviewer.

packet.pin_provenance: trusted frozen parent baseline; cached reference-to-tree identity plus exact per-blob bytes reverified offline, no fresh default/tag/network discovery

remaining_evidence_obligations.description: Source expressions use generated C sizes/alignment/endian, longdouble representation and CPython/ctypes platform behavior. No actual reference build/runtime receipt exists; two model profiles are illustrative only.

Caller protocol/ordering/NotImplemented/error behavior is source-defined, but arbitrary valid registered callback bodies carry their own semantics. Complete extension registration/lifecycle and first-party execution remain unverified.

All descriptor families remain admitted: object, structured, subarray, temporal, fixed/managed strings, custom/legacy user types, aliases/protocols. Full cross-product of descriptor parameters, Python hooks, warnings/errors and compiler variants is not materialized byselected function witnesses.

can_cast/type promotion is metadata policy. Exact actual casting payload conversion, same_value rejection, complex warnings, fenv/subnormals/overflow and object/NA allocation/finalization require separate complete kernels/contracts and execution.

Selected C bodies/control sites are lexical, not preprocessor/CFG/formal verification. Further CPython/npy compatibility/import/allocation helper effects and build macros require exact environment interpretation; source availability alone is not API semantic closure.
All concrete reference/provider case specifications are unrun. Actual CPU ISA/device/gradient/layout/performance tests, independent review and release gates remain open.

Registered temporal resolver has an integer-quotient metric-prefix NO/EQUIV branch, not merely equal base/multiplier metadata;2001ms versus2s is a source-derived mismatch question pending exact binary comparison. No reference-bug waiver or scope exclusion.
NumPy supplies no AD semantics. Discrete dtype tags/query results do not justify severing custom/object graph payloads; Coeus differentiation behavior needs explicit consumer rules.

source_semantic_review.assessment: Preserves full keyword mapping and duplicate/unknown checks before declaration-order converters, followed by missing-required checks; converter and outer-override invocation errors remain distinct from later resolver-query suppression. Lookup failure is cleared at the type-object __array_function__ lookup boundary only.
source_semantic_review.subject: native argument and override phases

source_semantic_review.assessment: Single-input result_type canonicalizes the discovered descriptor; exact Python integer value/range can select intp, longlong, unsigned longlong, or object during discovery. Multi-input exact Python int/float/complex temporary flags replace discovered descriptors with abstract kinds; bool and subclasses do not receive these exact-type flags. The packet explicitly corrects the older unconditional no-value-effect wording, without casting-payload credit.
source_semantic_review.subject: single versus multi-input scalar descriptor abstraction

source_semantic_review.assessment: The advertised-safety fast path can bypass resolver invocation. Otherwise registered cast lookup/resolution supplies descriptor safety; CanCastTypeTo and ordinary CanCastArrayTo clear a negative lookup/resolver result into False. Earlier public dtype conversion and outer override body errors propagate. Internal Python-literal flags are not presented as normal public zero-dimensional-array value promotion.
source_semantic_review.subject: actual registered casting paths versus legacy helpers

source_semantic_review.assessment: Keeps identical native legacy non-VOID promotion fast path and nonparametric default-descriptor metadata loss separate. Recursive fields, names/titles, recomputed padding/alignment, subarray shape, object ownership/view offsets and native byte order remain descriptor-family rules rather than one universal associative promotion law. Casting metadata does not grant write aliasing permission.
source_semantic_review.subject: descriptor identity, structured/subarray and byte order

source_semantic_review.assessment: StringDType is not silently excluded or conflated with fixed S/U. Its String-to-Unicode registered cast advertises SAME_KIND; a SAFE query can invoke the unspecified-size rejecting resolver and clear its error to False, whereas SAME_KIND may bypass resolution. Hook presence-versus-absence, ctypes probe suppression-versus-conversion propagation, user callbacks, lifecycle and payload conversion remain explicit. Arbitrary callback programs and full registration/build/lifetime evidence remain open.
source_semantic_review.subject: managed strings, object and custom dtype protocols

source_semantic_review.assessment: Within-datetime and within-timedelta initialization installs time_to_time_resolve_descriptors, rather than relying solely on legacy can_cast_* metadata helpers. The positive integer-division branch has 2001//2 == 1000 at the ms-to-s enum gap, allowing the source-derived NO/EQUIV branch despite unequal mathematical durations. The packet leaves exact frozen-binary public behavior, descriptor normalization, payload conversion and documented-no-cast reconciliation open. No runtime bug, waiver, exclusion or observed result is asserted by this review.
source_semantic_review.subject: temporal quotient source/documentation question

source_semantic_review.assessment: Independently reconstructed all 576 source row-family predicates, compared every serialized C expression and predicate AST, and independently recomputed both 576-cell illustrative profile booleans. Read the literal scalar initializer traversal and checked all profile promotion symmetry/deferred cells. This is not a C preprocessor run, actual ABI observation, floating representation proof, full public descriptor relation or casting payload execution.
source_semantic_review.subject: symbolic safe table and ABI model

source_semantic_review.assessment: Eunomia is the planned numeric dtype/promotion policy owner; Leto handles array/dtype argument and interop lifecycle boundaries. Mnemosyne/Melinoe are storage/access-proof suppliers, Coeus consumes the policy and defines its AD boundary, and Hephaestus supplies actual device kernels. No implementation/codeowner ADR approval is claimed. Field/subarray geometry and dtype ABI decisions must retain Leto/Eunomia policy ownership while Melinoe supplies access/validity proofs.
source_semantic_review.subject: single API owner and provider suppliers
